query: SK Hynix ADR Nasdaq listing SKHY first trading date July 2026 latest news, pricing date, roadshow status, SEC review as of late June 2026. Is July 10 still the expected trading date? Any reports of delay or schedule slippage?
answer:
## Summary

**The July 10 date held — there was no delay.** Although as of the June 24, 2026 filing SK Hynix called July 10 "tentative and subject to change," the listing proceeded exactly on schedule:

- **Priced:** Thursday, July 9, 2026 at **$149.00/ADR**
- **Debut:** Friday, July 10, 2026 on Nasdaq Global Select Market — opened at **$170** (~14% above offer), closed day one at **$168.01** (up ~13%)
- **Raised:** ~**$26.5 billion** via **177.9 million ADRs** (10 ADRs = 1 share) — largest-ever U.S. share sale by a foreign company
- **Ticker:** temporary **SKHYV** at debut → regular-way **SKHY** the following session (~July 13)
- **SEC review & roadshow:** completed on time (F-1/A filings, EDGAR CIK 2120882); no SEC-related delay reported

The only deviation from the original plan was the size — the June 24 filing headlined ~$29B, while the final raise came in lower at ~$26.5B — but the **timing/schedule did not slip.**

Note: The question framed this "as of late June 2026," but the events have since resolved — the listing successfully occurred on the expected July 10 date.
